title: Ops uses the customer journey and status instead of the obsolete eight-step pipeline
steps: Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to a test PostgreSQL instance. The test helper creates and removes only its own scratch database.
Run the command in run.cmd from the repository root. Require zero skipped tests.
Read assertions comparing Ops with the customer API, and status parity with the actual customer statusView.
expect: Zero failures and zero skipped tests.
Ops/customer stages and Attention agree for completed research, stopped refresh, accepted demo action, latest QA failure and deleted demo across accounts.
Done with pictures and no handoff/QA is Needs review in Demo, not uploading or LEASED.
Customer milestone filters exclude Attention; All retains loaded rows. New stage URLs round-trip and legacy numerical links still work.
Missing account scope is refused by the shared SQL helper.
